'''Alis''' works as a serving woman in the [[Tarasin Palace]] in [[Ebou Dar]], [[Altara]]. She is described as being plump and short of her middle years.
==Activities==
When [[Mat]] goes to check on [[Olver]] and see how he is settling into his rooms in the Tarasin Palace, he sees three serving women fussing over him. Olver is paying them compliments; according to him, [[Haesel]] has the most beautiful eyes, and Alis and [[Loya]] are so sweet that he could never choose between them. Alis stops unpacking his saddlebags long enough to give him a broad grin.
